📌 Booking Rules
💰 Security Deposit — A refundable security deposit of ₱200–₱1,000 is required to confirm your booking, depending on the length of your stay. The deposit must be paid via bank transfer or e-wallet. It is 100% refundable upon check-out, provided there are no damages and all house rules have been observed.
📅 Cancellation Policy — If you cancel your booking at least one (1) day before the scheduled check-in, your security deposit will be fully refunded. However, if the cancellation is made on the same day as the scheduled check-in, the deposit will be forfeited — unless you are able to provide a legitimate replacement guest.
💵 Full Payment — The remaining balance may be settled in full upon arrival at the unit.
👥 Additional Guests — The standard booking accommodates a maximum of 2 pax. Additional guests are subject to extra charges: ₱300 per adult and ₱150 per child aged 6 years old and above. Children 5 years old and below are admitted free of charge.
👤 Valid ID Required — Each guest must present one (1) valid government-issued ID for building entry verification upon check-in.
